privacy.telemetryHint: Gostman has no telemetry, analytics or crash reporting. It contacts only the hosts you send requests to and the services you set up yourself.
privacy.updatesHint: Once a day, read the latest release from GitHub and show it in the status bar. Nothing is downloaded or installed.
privacy.updatesFailed: The last check did not reach GitHub. It runs again tomorrow.
privacy.updateHint: Open the release notes and downloads on GitHub
privacy.relayHint: The hosted relay cannot reach localhost or private addresses. A local relay sends requests from this computer, with nobody in between.
privacy.relayAddressHint: Start it with gostman relay and enter the address it prints.
privacy.relayAddressInvalid: Enter an address such as http://127.0.0.1:4030.
privacy.relayMissing: Enter the address of the local relay under Preferences, Privacy, or switch back to the hosted relay.
privacy.relayUnreachable: The local relay at {{address}} did not answer. Start it with gostman relay, or switch back to the hosted relay under Preferences, Privacy.
privacy.relayCheckUnreachable: The local relay at {{address}} did not answer. Check that gostman relay is running and that the address matches the one it printed.
